aluminum_melting_3_subtask_structure_ret.name: Aluminum Structure Retrieval for Melting - Level 3
aluminum_melting_3_subtask_structure_ret.description: Retrieve structure of Aluminum and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

aluminum_melting_3_subtask_potential_fil.name: Aluminum Potential File for Melting - Level 3
aluminum_melting_3_subtask_potential_fil.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Aluminum for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

aluminum_melting_3_subtask_melting.name: Aluminum NPT Melting - Level 3
aluminum_melting_3_subtask_melting.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Aluminum structure file and EAM potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the melting of the system and return the Al–Al bond length after the phase change.
